metadata.title: Primitive Betti points over k[x,y,z] and the Heisenberg enveloping algebra: the point (1,2,2,1) on (0,e,3e,4e) fails only in characteristic 2 for 2 <= e <= 5, the pure pairs of forms form a family, and a census for d_3 <= 12
metadata.description:
Erman and Sam asked whether every integral point on a pure ray of the Boij-Söderberg cone is the Betti table of a finite length module over k[x,y,z] or over the enveloping algebra U of the Heisenberg Lie algebra; Jiang, Li, Sun, Wang, Xiao and Yu answered negatively in 2026.

We study the points that pass the Hilbert series parity test over U and are excluded over k[x,y,z], above all (1, 2, 2, 1) on (0, e, 3e, 4e). We prove that U/U(x^e, y^e) has this pure table if and only if char k = 0 or char k >= 2e, and that in characteristic 2 no module with a generators and at most a + 1 relations of one degree e >= 2 has finite length over U, so the point is realized over neither ring there. In odd characteristic below 2e explicit pairs of forms realize it, over F_3 and F_5 for e = 3, over F_3, F_5 and F_7 for e = 4 and 5, and over F_3 for e = 6; so for 2 <= e <= 5 it is realized over U if and only if char k is not 2, and for larger e the other odd characteristics below 2e stay open.

The pure pairs of forms of degree e are open in a determinantal locus, and every component of their locus has dimension at least 4e - 4; when char k = 0 or char k >= 2e they form such a family through <x^e, y^e>, of dimension exactly 4e - 4 there over the rationals for e = 4, ..., 7, and a linear four-parameter family through that point is pure in general for every e >= 4.

The census over k[x,y,z] of the 220 rays with d_3 <= 12 realizes the primitive point on 193 rays, excludes it on 12 and leaves 15 open; ten such rays are realized over U in characteristic 0, and in characteristic 0 the least counterexample has d_3 = 10.

Source code, data and computational records: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH. The paper does not claim a negative answer to Question 6.1 of Erman and Sam, which is due to Jiang, Li, Sun, Wang, Xiao and Yu, and claims no priority for any other result.

metadata.version_notes: Adds the realization of (1,2,2,1) on (0,e,3e,4e) in odd characteristic below 2e by explicit pairs of forms (e = 3 and 4, e = 5 in characteristics 3, 5 and 7, and e = 6 in characteristic 3), so that the point fails only in characteristic 2 for 2 <= e <= 5; the theorem that the pure pairs of forms of degree e form, in characteristic 0 or at least 2e, a family of dimension at least 4e - 4 through (x^e, y^e), with its exact dimension at that pair over the rationals for e = 4 to 7 and a linear family; and the archived machine checks of the characteristic 2 theorem. Corrects the size and SHA-256 printed for one manifest file, which belonged to a copy with CRLF line ends.
